Name: Horny Festivals
Author: Girafarig
Description:
This mod adds four new festivals to the game, in which the men of town hook up and have gay sex. Because why not? :)

The festivals are as follows:

Spring 19: Virility Festival - Secret Woods
Summer 20: FuckFest - Beach
Fall 12: Phallic Celebration - Town
Winter 13: Day of Carnality - Pierre's/Completed Community Center

This mod is meant to be used in tandem with my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors[/url]﻿, and indeed requires it to function properly.

Of course, you also need Content Patcher and SMAPI.

[b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]
The folders "HF" and "FestivalWarps" go into the Mods folder.

I think thats all of it! Let me know any questions, concerns, improvements, everything!
